item.title: Mirai wa Bokura no Te no Naka ni
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shape Shifter
  • 発売日: 2001-02-16
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 未来はぼくらの手のなかに
  • 英語名: Mirai wa Bokura no Te no Naka ni

别名

  • miraboku

あらすじ

In girls school there is a legend that on a full moon night there are 13 stairs in a staircase of an old school building instead of 12, and that the curse of the city is linked with these 13 stairs.

On a full moon night two weeks before cultural festival main character witnesses a girl staying on 13 stairs. Has she got cursed? As school festival draws near, mysterious phenomena occur one by one. Will protagonist be able to lift the curse from the girl with the help of his friends before the festival?

item.title: Tsubasa no Hatameki ~A sound of her wings~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shape Shifter
  • 発売日: 2000-04-07
  • スコア: 5.86/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 翼のはためき ～A sound of her wings～
  • 英語名: Tsubasa no Hatameki A sound of her wings

あらすじ

Yuzawa Yuuki is a pessimist. He thinks that life is meaningless since everyone is going to die one day.

Before the Christmas he meets a mysterious “angel” girl Mika. She claims that she came to save Yuuki from his desperate state. He doubts her sanity but decides to play along. After that self-proclaimed “devils” appear. Some of them aim to claim Mika’s life, others are here to tempt Yuuki.

item.title: Partner ~Sekai de Ichiban Taisetsu na Hito~
item.description:

  • スコア: 5.74/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Partner ～世界でいちばんたいせつなひと～
  • 英語名: Partner Sekai de Ichiban Taisetsu na Hito

别名

  • Partner ～世界で一番たいせつなひと～

あらすじ

Main character is a teacher who gets to know one day that he is very popular among girls.

Erika is anxious to astonish him with culinary skills.

Natsuki keeps her grades up and involves teacher in serious talks about future career.

Sakaki is an artist who feels joy after being praised by the teacher.
